title: labelwatch semantic_relations fixture record (LW-JEV-SHADOW-v0 §5.9)
description: One JSONL line: an authored synthetic post pair with a structural relation, a gold relation from the §5.4 vocabulary, an ambiguity note, and the acceptable-answer set. Evaluation material only; several classes legitimately gold underdetermined.

text_a.description: Post A's text (the structural target). No DIDs, AT-URIs, or handle mentions.

text_b.description: Post B's text. May be empty only when relation_type is repost (bare repost carries no text).

gold_relation.description: Gold relation from the frozen §5.4 vocabulary.

acceptable_answers.description: Expected-acceptable answer set. MUST contain gold_relation; that cross-field rule is enforced by the python validator (labelwatch.semantic_shadow.validate_fixture_record), which is normative where this schema is silent.

ambiguity_note.description: Why this pair is or is not ambiguous; authored, not generated.
